breakpoints.name: narrow-panel
breakpoints.purpose: Maximum-width query hides step names and reduces manuscript padding.

extensions.highContrast: Host tokens replace semantic foreground/background/border/action/focus and state fills. Unavailable text uses --vscode-disabledForeground with --vscode-foreground fallback.

components.name: Primary action
components.description: One next action, full width, using host action colors in high contrast.
components.css: .ds-primary{min-height:44px;width:100%;padding:8px 12px;border:1px solid var(--vd-primary);border-radius:6px;background:var(--vd-primary);color:var(--vd-on-ochre);font:600 14px/1.5 var(--vd-interface);transition:transform var(--vd-press) ease-out}.ds-primary:hover{outline:1px solid var(--vd-text);outline-offset:-4px}.ds-primary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--vd-focus);outline-offset:2px}.ds-primary:active{transform:scale(.98)}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-primary{transition:none}.ds-primary:active{transform:none}}

components.html: Available after saving a change and refreshing the source.

narrative.overview: A manuscript margin beside native source. The confirmed rule, current investigation and next action remain clear. Explanations remain distinct from executed evidence.
dos: Use semantic tokens and local fonts.
Preserve current-source identities and host consent.
donts: Do not imply runtime path tracing from explanations.
Do not invent authorship or percentage progress.
Do not use emoji icons, shadows, gradients or runtime font fetch.
